tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search live job postings from 30+ sources in one schema. Use it to find who is hiring for a role, skill or place, not for coverage or cost questions. Returns real matching postings (title, company, location, salary, tech stack, apply URL), capped at 3 rows per call on this no-key server, with whethe

tools.name: list_job_sources
tools.description: List the job boards and ATS platforms JobsPipe documents, collected or not. Use it to check whether a platform such as Workday is covered before searching; it returns no jobs. Returns, per platform, name, slug, a summary that says when it is not collected, coverage when it is, and page URL.

tools.name: list_pricing_plans
tools.description: List JobsPipe plans and what they cost. Use it for price, credit or plan-fit questions; it returns no jobs. Returns, per plan, USD price and period, credits, price per 1,000 credits, features and signup URL, plus extra-credit and Enterprise terms.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_jobs" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
